name: Valentino
source:
The boss (Capo) of the north werewolf crime organization Oruma Rossa. While being the head of a criminal organization, Valentino is proud to receive the respect of many celebrities. He despises being involved in drug dealership. Valentino was [url=/c12330]Romeo[/url]'s guardian once.

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=306925]Getchu[/url].]
